name: Sundial
author: jubnl
description: Sunrise, sunset, golden hour and blue hour for every day of your trip, computed from where you will actually be.

settings.label: Golden hour ends at sun altitude
settings.hint: Golden hour always starts 4 degrees below the horizon; this sets how high the sun may climb before the light is no longer golden.

settings.label: Clock
settings.hint: How Sundial writes times in the trip tab, the planner rows, the place panel, the PDF and its assistant tools.

mcpTools.name: sun_times
mcpTools.title: Sun times
mcpTools.description: Sunrise, sunset, golden hour and blue hour. Pass tripId (and optionally dayId) for a trip's days, computed from where the traveller will be; or pass date, lat and lng for any place on any date. An IANA zone is honoured in both modes; in trip mode it overrides the trip's pinned zone for this answer only. Any phase the sun never reaches that day is null.

tripId.description: A trip the requesting user can access.

dayId.description: One day of that trip; omit for every day.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, used with lat and lng. Defaults to today.

zone.description: IANA time zone for the answer, e.g. Asia/Tokyo. Trip mode: overrides the trip's pinned zone for this answer. Coordinate mode: estimated from the location (a region table, then longitude) when omitted.

mcpTools.name: list_shoot_days
mcpTools.title: List shoot days
mcpTools.description: The days of a trip marked for photography, with their sun times and notes.

mcpTools.name: mark_shoot_day
mcpTools.title: Mark a shoot day
mcpTools.description: Mark or unmark a day of a trip as a photography shoot day, with an optional note. Shared with every member of the trip.

on.description: true to mark, false to clear.
